# Pinecrest Mountain Rentals — Canyons Village Comp-Set Analysis

**Generated by: Marketing & Distribution skill**
**Segment:** Ski-In/Ski-Out Condos at Canyons Village (Pinecrest's PC-01 to PC-08)
**Comp-set scrape:** Apr 28, 2026 via Firecrawl
**Marketing lead:** Priya Shah
**Distributed to:** Riley (pricing), Hannah (renewal pitches), Jamie (strategy)

---

## Why this analysis

Canyons Village is one of our two highest-RevPAR segments (lakefront being the other). With 8 properties, it's also our largest segment by property count. We're entering summer — a softer season for ski-in/ski-out vs. winter — and the comp set has shifted in the past 12 months. This analysis answers: **where are we under-priced, over-priced, missing an amenity story, or losing on photo strength?**

Bottom line: **we're well-positioned on price and reviews, but losing on Booking.com presence (we have zero) and on summer-specific listing copy (most of our 8 listings still lead with skiing).** Two specific changes recommended; one strategic change going to the board.

---

## Comp-Set Methodology

**Universe scraped:** All STR listings within Canyons Village mapped polygon, 1BR to 4BR, professionally managed. Total: **47 listings** found.

**Comp-set narrowed to:** 14 listings (subset of 47) most similar to Pinecrest's 8 in: bed count, amenity tier, photo quality, and direct-booking-channel mix.

| Indie host: "Canyons Carl" | 2 | 35% direct, 50% Airbnb, 15% VRBO | n/a (self-managed) |
| Local indie hosts | 3 | varied | n/a |

## Review Score Comparison

| Operator | Avg review score (Airbnb) | # reviews per listing (avg) | Superhost / Premier % |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **Pinecrest (8 listings)** | **4.91** | 124 | 100% Superhost (8 of 8) |
| AvantStay | 4.79 | 87 | 50% (1 of 2) |
| Evolve | 4.71 | 102 | 33% (1 of 3) |
| Vacasa | 4.68 | 156 | 25% (1 of 4) |
| Indie hosts (avg) | 4.85 | 64 | varied |

**Read:** We dominate on reviews. This is our brand moat. Every host in the comp set has more total reviews than some of ours (because we're younger), but our score is structurally higher.

**Why:** AI Ambassador response time + cleanliness + pre-arrival comms. Our 4.91 vs. Vacasa's 4.68 is a real gap that translates to: better Airbnb listing rank, more repeat bookings, more direct-booking pivot.

**Action:** Continue investing in CSAT — this is what sustains the price premium.

## Channel Mix — The Booking.com Gap

This is the single biggest finding.

| Operator | % via Booking.com (Canyons Village segment) | Estimated incremental annual revenue |
|---|---:|---:|
| Vacasa | 20% | ~$72K per listing |
| Indie host (Canyons Carl) | 0% | $0 |
| AvantStay | 14% | ~$58K per listing |
| Evolve | 6% | ~$22K per listing |
| **Pinecrest** | **0%** | **$0** |

**Read:** Vacasa's Booking.com presence is the single biggest revenue advantage they have over us in this segment. Their guest acquisition leans heavily on Booking.com's international + business-travel demand.

**Estimated revenue we're leaving on the table:** $58K–$120K across our 8 ski-in/ski-out condos per year. The 6 condos most aligned with Booking.com's audience (PC-01, PC-02, PC-05, PC-06, PC-07, PC-08) are the obvious onboarding targets.

**Action:** Already in flight. Booking.com onboarding is on the GM's list for Sep 1 launch (decision pending board approval). My strong recommendation: **say yes to launch.**

## Listing-Copy & Photo Comparison

### Pinecrest's existing 8 listings (Apr 28 audit)

| Listing | Title strength | First-photo punch | Description structure | Summer keywords | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PC-01 (Aspen Loft) | OK — leads with "Ski-In" | OK — interior shot, fine | Standard 4-section | Weak: 0 mentions of summer activities | Re-write needed |
| PC-02 (Powder Pine #214) | Strong | Strong | Solid | Weak | Photo ok, copy needs summer pivot |
| PC-03 (Slopeside Studio) | OK | Weak — old photo | Brief | Weak | Re-shoot + rewrite priority |
| PC-04 (Eagle's Perch) | Strong | Strong | Solid | OK — 2 mentions | Best of the 8 |
| PC-05 (Snowflower #312) | OK | OK | Standard | None | Rewrite needed |
| PC-06 (Birch Suite) | OK | OK | Standard | None | Rewrite needed |
| PC-07 (Canyons Crest) | OK | OK | Standard | None | Rewrite needed |
| PC-08 (Cedar Walk-Up) | Weak — generic | Weak | Brief | None | Lowest-priority but weakest |

**Pattern:** Our listings were written for the ski season. Going into summer, we need to talk about Canyons Village's mountain biking, summer concert series, alpine slide, hiking access from the gondola — the things actually drawing summer guests.

### Comp-set listing strength (Apr 28 audit, sample)

| Operator | Common pattern |
|---|---|
| Vacasa | Generic templated copy ("This unit features X, Y, Z"). Photos polished but cookie-cutter. Strength: amenity-tag completeness. |
| AvantStay | High-quality photography. Lifestyle copy. Strong on summer angles ("explore Park City's 400+ miles of trail"). |
| Evolve | Functional copy, low-effort photography. Strength: price point. |
| Indie (Canyons Carl) | Personal voice, owner-narrated. Photos are mid. Strength: charm + repeat guest list. |

**Read:** AvantStay is doing what we should be doing on the lifestyle copy. Their photos are at our level — but their summer-keyword density is 3× higher.

**Action:** Rewrite all 8 PC condo listings with summer pivot. Priority order: PC-08, PC-03, PC-01 first; rest follow.

## Amenity Gap Analysis

What our comp set has that we don't (across ski-in/out condos):

| Amenity | % of comp set | % of Pinecrest's 8 | Lift potential |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| In-unit washer/dryer | 100% | 100% | No gap |
| Hot tub (private balcony or shared) | 50% | 25% (2 of 8) | +$30/night ADR |
| Mountain view (specific call-out) | 80% | 88% | No gap |
| Garage parking (vs. open lot) | 30% | 38% | No gap |
| EV charger | 25% | 12% (1 of 8 — PC-04) | +$15/night ADR |
| Pre-stocked kitchen starter (coffee, salt, oil) | 10% | 100% | Pinecrest advantage — call this out in copy |
| Bike storage / ski-equipment storage | 70% | 88% | No gap |
| Smart-lock entry | 100% | 100% | No gap |
| AI concierge / 24-hr SMS support | 0% (Pinecrest unique) | 100% | **Pinecrest unique advantage — under-marketed** |

**Read:** We're missing on EV chargers (3 of 8 properties could install — owner-charged, $1,200 each). We're under-marketing our pre-stocked kitchens and AI concierge — these are differentiators no one else has.

**Action:** (1) Write up EV charger options for 3 owner conversations (PC-01 Sandra Park, PC-05/PC-06/PC-07 Westridge LLC); (2) update all listings to lead with "AI concierge: text us anytime" callout in the "what's special" block.

## Recommended Actions

### Quick wins (this month)

1. **Listing rewrite: PC-08 + PC-03 + PC-01** — pivot to summer copy + Canyons Village summer activities (gondola, biking, concerts). Estimated lift: +$2,400/month combined when summer demand kicks in.
2. **Add AI concierge / "text us anytime" call-out** to all 8 condo listings (Airbnb's "what's special" block + VRBO description). Cost: ~30 min/listing. Estimated lift: +0.5 pp in conversion rate.
3. **Re-shoot PC-03 and PC-08 in next 4 weeks** — both have outdated photography that's hurting conversion. Lumen Mountain Studio at $1,800 each (already negotiated rate). Estimated lift: +1.4 pp conversion.

### Strategic (decision needed from GM/board)

4. **Booking.com onboarding for 6 condos starting Sep 1** — projected $180K–$280K incremental annual revenue across 6 properties. (Already on the board's June 15 decision list.)

### Longer-term

5. **EV charger conversation with 3 owners** (Sandra, Westridge LLC) at next quarterly review — owner-charged $1,200/each, justifies +$15/night ADR.
